hash_policy: content_sha256 is SHA-256 of exact_quote encoded as UTF-8 unless hash_scope says full_pdf

items.exact_quote: Twelve-month rolling average order acceleration in Electrical Americas, up 16%, driven by data center momentum. The twelve-month rolling average of orders in the fourth quarter was up 16% organically. Backlog at the end of December remained strong and was up 31% over December 2024.
items.limitations: Segment-wide demand evidence; does not identify transformer, switchgear, UPS or PDU share and does not prove customer single-sourcing.

items.exact_quote: Sales for the Electrical Americas segment were a record $3.5 billion, up 21% from the fourth quarter of 2024. The sales increase consisted of 15% growth in organic sales, 5% growth from acquisitions and 1% growth from foreign exchange. Operating profits were a record $1.0 billion, up 14% over the fourth quarter of 2024, and operating margins in the quarter were 29.8%.
items.limitations: Supports segment earnings transmission but not product-level material revenue.

items.exact_quote: Eaton is helping address the critical shortage of transformers and record demand for its solutions across utility, large commercial, industrial and data center customers. The company is investing $340 million to increase U.S. production of its three-phase transformers essential to reliable electrical power. Production and hiring at Eaton's new Jonesville, South Carolina facility is expected to begin in 2027.
items.limitations: Proves shortage, demand exposure and a future capacity action. It does not prove current qualified output, current relief, market share or customer qualification.

items.exact_quote: Orders momentum accelerated significantly with fourth quarter organic orders up approximately 252% compared to last year's fourth quarter and up 117% sequentially from third quarter 2025. While the Americas region and hyperscale/colocation data centers were the primary drivers of order strength, order growth was broad-based across regions, technologies and customers. The company's trailing twelve-month organic orders grew approximately 81% compared to the prior year period, reflecting robust market demand, particularly in AI infrastructure. Fourth quarter 2025 book-to-bill ratio was approximately 2.9x and backlog increased to $15.0 billion, up 109% compared to the same period last year.
items.limitations: Demand and backlog cover the whole portfolio; they do not isolate critical power from liquid cooling or prove displacement.

items.exact_quote: Vertiv reported fourth quarter net sales of $2,880 million, an increase of $534 million, or 23%, compared to fourth quarter 2024, driven by organic sales growth of 19%. Fourth quarter operating profit of $580 million increased $123 million and adjusted operating profit of $668 million increased $164 million, up 27% and 33%, respectively, from fourth quarter 2024. Adjusted operating margin was 23.2%, up 170 basis points compared to fourth quarter 2024, driven by operational leverage on higher volume, productivity and favorable price-cost, partially offset by tariff impact.
items.limitations: Company-level earnings transmission only; no product revenue denominator.

items.exact_quote: Orders amounted to EUR14.2bn. Book-to-bill ratio was strong at 1.36. As a result, order backlog rose to a new high of EUR138 billion at fiscal year-end. Revenue was EUR10.4bn, an increase of 9.7% on a comparable basis, driven by Grid Technologies, which posted its highest quarterly revenue to date. Demand for electricity and the need for modernization and expansion of electrical infrastructure should continue to increase, driven in particular by the strong growth of data centers.
items.limitations: Group backlog is not transformer backlog; data-center language in Outlook is forward-looking.

items.exact_quote: Grid Technologies plans to achieve a comparable revenue growth of 19% to 21% (actual figure FY 2025: 25.4%) and a Profit margin before Special items between 16% and 18% (actual figure FY 2025: 15.8%).
items.limitations: Segment result includes more than transformers and switchgear; the future range is guidance.

items.location: Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Highlights
items.exact_quote: Fourth quarter orders were $22.2B, up 65% organically with growth in all segments, and backlog grew $15.0B sequentially from equipment and services at Power and Electrification. Full year orders were $59.3B, up 34% organically, led by equipment at Power and Electrification and services in each segment. Revenue was $38.1B, up 9% on a U.S. GAAP basis and organically, driven by growth in Electrification and Power.
items.limitations: Electrification includes more than transformers; no U.S.-only product denominator.

items.exact_quote: Total backlog grew $31.2B year-over-year; equipment margin in backlog grew by $8B, with 6 points of accretion. We expanded our 2025 backlog across equipment and services, with equipment margin in backlog expanding six points year-over-year, reflecting favorable price and our continued focus on disciplined underwriting.
items.limitations: Backlog margin is not recognized profit and is not transformer-specific.

items.exact_quote: Climate Solutions segment sales were $454.4 million, compared with $366.4 million one year ago, an increase of 24 percent. Data center sales increased 42 percent from the prior year. The segment reported gross margin of 24.6 percent, which was 440 basis points lower than the prior year. This decline included the negative impact of temporary costs related to the rapid expansion of manufacturing capacity for data center products. The segment reported operating income of $62.2 million, a 4 percent decrease from the prior year, and adjusted EBITDA of $76.0 million, a decrease of 4 percent from the prior year.
items.limitations: Data-center absolute revenue is not given; Climate Solutions also includes HVAC products. Causal margin language is explicit.

items.exact_quote: Net cash provided by operating activities for the six months ended September 30, 2025 was $29.1 million, a decrease of $68.7 million compared to the prior year. Free cash flow for the six months ended September 30, 2025 was negative $30.3 million, a decrease of $87.8 million from the prior year. This decrease was due to an increase in working capital, primarily related to higher inventory balances in Climate Solutions, and higher capital expenditures to support growth in Data Centers.
items.limitations: One six-month period; does not establish permanent impairment or a failed long-run return.

items.exact_quote: The new 160,000 square-foot site will expand nVent's capacity to manufacture data center liquid cooling solutions, supporting the surging demand for liquid cooling technologies that enable artificial intelligence and high-performance computing. This marks nVent's third data center liquid cooling capacity expansion in three years, adding more than 400,000 square feet of new space.
items.limitations: Square footage and planned capacity do not prove qualified sellable output, customer adoption, utilization or share.

items.exact_quote: Vertiv develops energy-efficient cooling and power reference architecture for the NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 platform, available as SimReady assets in NVIDIA Omniverse Blueprint for AI factory design and operations.
items.limitations: Reference architecture and collaboration are not production qualification, sellable capacity or customer recurring use.

items.publisher: U.S. National Institute of Standards and Technology
items.exact_quote: EUVL systems currently cost a reported $150 million and were first deployed in 2019 by ASML, which maintains a 100% market share. The only company that currently manufactures EUVL scanner assemblies is ASML based in the Netherlands. ASML sells the EUV scanner assemblies to companies like Intel, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company, and Samsung. These companies then implement the EUV scanners in their semiconductor fabrication facilities.
items.limitations: 2023 snapshot; current validity must be refreshed with later ASML filings and challenger search.

items.exact_quote: We recognized four EXE and 44 NXE systems in sales in 2025 compared to two EXE and 42 NXE systems in 2024.
items.limitations: System sales prove repeated commercial delivery, not on their own customer single-source dependence or delivery superiority.

items.exact_quote: We compete primarily with Canon and Nikon in respect of DUV systems. Both have substantial financial resources and broad patent portfolios. Each continues to offer products that compete directly with our DUV systems. We also face competition from new competitors with substantial financial resources, as well as from those driven by the ambition of self-sufficiency in the geopolitical context. Furthermore, we may face competition from alternative technological solutions or semiconductor manufacturing processes.
items.limitations: The filing says Canon and Nikon compete in DUV, not that all future EUV alternatives are impossible. It also explicitly warns about new and alternative competition.

items.exact_quote: Apple today announced it will transition the Mac to its world-class custom silicon to deliver industry-leading performance and powerful new technologies. Apple plans to ship the first Mac with Apple silicon by the end of the year and complete the transition in about two years.
items.limitations: Announcement and plan; not actual adoption or displacement until later evidence.

items.location: macOS Big Sur Enables Transition to Apple Silicon
items.exact_quote: Using Universal 2 application binaries, developers will be able to easily create a single app that taps into the native power and performance of the new Macs with Apple silicon, while still supporting Intel-based Macs. With the translation technology of Rosetta 2, users will be able to run existing Mac apps that have not yet been updated, including those with plug-ins.
items.limitations: Proves migration tooling and technical feasibility, not full ecosystem completion at announcement date.

items.location: Mac Transition to Apple Silicon Now Complete
items.exact_quote: With M2 Ultra powering the new Mac Pro, the Mac transition to Apple silicon is now complete, revolutionizing the laptop and desktop experience.
items.limitations: Directly proves product-line replacement completion; does not separately quantify procurement share by period.

items.exact_quote: M2 Ultra features a more powerful CPU that is 20 percent faster than M1 Ultra, a larger GPU that is up to 30 percent faster, and a Neural Engine that is up to 40 percent faster. With Mac Studio powered by M2 Ultra, colorists using DaVinci Resolve will experience up to 50 percent faster video processing compared to Mac Studio with M1 Ultra.
items.limitations: Apple-controlled benchmark versus prior Apple Silicon generation; combined with shipped product lineage, it supports repeated performance but is not an independent benchmark against Intel.

items.exact_quote: HP in the USA tested Asetek's data center water cooling several years ago and knows that it works, but, with no demand, they aren't adopting it.
items.limitations: Undated company-authored historical statement. Valid as a negative adoption counterexample, not as a current 2026 company state.

items.exact_quote: At the Yuzawa GX Data Center in Japan, Getworks has deployed Supermicro's liquid-cooled solutions to deliver next-generation AI-ready data centers.
items.limitations: Named deployment but outside the U.S.; no delivery-cycle count, market share or displacement evidence.

items.exact_quote: The report finds that data centers consumed about 4.4% of total U.S. electricity in 2023 and are expected to consume approximately 6.7 to 12% of total U.S. electricity by 2028. The report indicates that total data center electricity usage climbed from 58 TWh in 2014 to 176 TWh in 2023 and estimates an increase between 325 to 580 TWh by 2028.
items.limitations: National demand forecast with a wide range; it does not identify a specific equipment category, signed project load, or supplier.

items.location: 2025 RISC ERO Reliability Risk Priorities Report, PDF page 12
items.exact_quote: In addition to generation equipment constraints, high-voltage transformers have persistently faced long lead times, posing challenges to all sources of generation.
items.limitations: Establishes persistent long lead times, not a numerical duration, supplier concentration, or a named blocked data-center project.

items.location: 2025 RISC ERO Reliability Risk Priorities Report, PDF page 44
items.exact_quote: These facilities, which can demand hundreds of megawatts at a single site and thousands of megawatts in a geographically small area, operate continuously, have minimal tolerance for power quality issues, and can be interconnected rapidly, often outpacing the development of accompanying transmission and generation.
items.limitations: Supports downstream criticality and possible grid-node transition, but not a named equipment failure, outage, or supplier-specific dependency.

items.exact_quote: Our EUV lithography systems make it possible to print the smallest features on microchips at the highest density, and are used for the most intricate, critical layers on the most advanced microchips. Compared to complex multiple-patterning strategies using deep ultraviolet (DUV) immersion systems, EUV systems help simplify our customers' manufacturing processes. Therefore, we collaborate closely with customers to lower manufacturing costs by shifting from complex multi-patterning to simpler single patterning using EUV lithography, a method that requires only one exposure per layer. This approach reduces the number of masks and process steps, while also improving yield and scalability for advanced Logic and Memory nodes. ASML is currently the world's only manufacturer of EUV lithography systems.
items.limitations: Company-authored technical comparison. NIST independently corroborates the only-manufacturer statement; the passage does not prove that future alternatives can never emerge.

items.exact_quote: Our TWINSCAN NXE platform was first introduced in 2013 and is now widely adopted in high-volume manufacturing by our major customers. In 2025, we shipped TWINSCAN NXE:3800E systems to our customers at full specification, which includes 220 wafers-per-hour throughput - a 37% improvement compared to the TWINSCAN NXE:3600D. We completed field upgrades to bring systems that were already in customer fabs to the same specifications. The rollout across the installed base remains on track.
items.limitations: Supports current high-volume adoption, full-spec delivery and installed-base integration; it is not independent customer testimony.

items.exact_quote: During the R&D phase, our customers rely on computational lithography to optimize the imaging conditions of our systems and develop the recipes to optimize reticle patterns to achieve the best pattern fidelity. This ensures robust, manufacturable designs that deliver high yields. Our installed base continues to grow. To provide the best value proposition, we offer an extensive portfolio to manage our installed base, including a wide range of service and upgrade options designed to improve throughput, patterning performance and overlay.
items.limitations: Supports customer-specific process integration and installed-base dependence; it does not quantify switching cost or downtime.

items.location: Performance footnotes, World's best CPU performance per watt
items.exact_quote: Testing conducted by Apple in October 2020 using preproduction 13-inch MacBook Pro systems with Apple M1 chip and 16GB of RAM. Performance per watt refers to the ratio of peak CPU performance to average power consumed using select industry standard benchmarks. Comparison made against high-performing CPUs for notebooks and desktops, commercially available at the time of testing.
items.limitations: Apple-controlled benchmark, but it names the comparison class and test basis; it does not provide independent laboratory replication.

items.location: Start of a Two-Year Transition for the Mac
items.exact_quote: M1 powers the new MacBook Air, 13-inch MacBook Pro, and Mac mini. They join the rest of the Mac product line to form the strongest Mac lineup ever. This is the beginning of a transition to a new family of chips designed specifically for the Mac.
items.limitations: Proves commercial launch across three Mac platforms; it does not by itself prove full-line displacement or two-period sustained supply.

items.location: macOS Big Sur Optimized for M1
items.exact_quote: With Big Sur and M1, Mac users can run a greater range of apps than ever before. All of Apple's Mac software is now Universal and runs natively on M1 systems. Existing Mac apps that have not been updated to Universal will run seamlessly with Apple's Rosetta 2 technology. And iPhone and iPad apps can now run directly on the Mac.
items.limitations: Directly supports ecosystem migration tooling and production compatibility; it does not measure third-party application coverage numerically.

items.location: First Quarter Segment Review, PDF page 2
items.exact_quote: Data Centers segment sales were $348.6 million, compared with $183.7 million one year ago, an increase of 90 percent. This increase was primarily driven by higher sales to hyperscale customers in North America. The segment reported gross margin of 20.2 percent, which was 960 basis points lower than the prior year. This decrease was primarily due to higher expenses related to the capacity expansion in North America combined with the temporary impact of production inefficiencies due to supply chain constraints, higher material costs, and higher warranty expense. The segment reported operating income of $46.3 million, a 33 percent increase from the prior year, and adjusted EBITDA of $51.7 million, an increase of 27 percent from the prior year.
items.limitations: The Data Centers segment is now separately reported and material, but the quarter contains temporary ramp, supply-chain, material and warranty effects; it does not isolate each cost component.

items.exact_quote: Free cash flow for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, was a use of $5.0 million, a decrease of $5.2 million from the prior year. This decrease was primarily due to higher capital expenditures to increase production capacity in the Data Centers segment, partially offset by favorable net changes in working capital.
items.limitations: Company-level free cash flow is causally linked to Data Centers capex, but the source does not disclose product-level payback or whether cash burden will exceed lifetime returns.

items.exact_quote: Our future is bright, evidenced by a landmark $4 billion long-term agreement for chiller sales with a major hyperscale customer, cementing Modine's position as a critical partner for data center cooling.
items.limitations: Supports demand persistence and a binding customer relationship, but also shows concentration in one major hyperscaler and does not disclose contract duration or margin.

items.exact_quote: Our first quarter was impacted by the supply chain constraints we discussed last quarter, which limited production and temporarily reduced margins within our Data Centers segment. We are taking decisive actions to secure supply, including working closely with our partners to lock in volume requirements while simultaneously qualifying additional suppliers.
items.limitations: Directly proves a current supply bottleneck and earnings drag, while also showing mitigation through additional-supplier qualification; it does not identify the constrained component or suppliers.
